Recruiters
From the Career Development Services Chair's Desk
Message from the Chairperson

Professor Nishant Kumar Verma

Chairperson, Career Development Services

Increasingly recognized as India's most innovative and internationally business-oriented school by recruiters, competitors, alumni, students and faculty alike, IIMB is steadily improving its ratings among the top ten business schools in the Asia Pacific region. Its students have an edge over nearly 50,000 other applicants in the selection process.

IIMB graduates go through a balanced but rigorous program covering core and optional courses over two years, offered by a distinguished faculty with substantive international teaching, research or consulting experience. Our students also build their managerial skills and perspectives as consultants with local firms and through interactions with top executives at industry forums and seminars on campus. As exchange students at top B-schools in North America, Europe and Australia, or through summer postings in different countries, the IIMB graduates also gain international cultural and corporate exposure that makes them ideal candidates for challenging roles in your organization. At IIMB, we pioneer new types of courses and frequently revise our curriculum to keep abreast of global trends in educational pedagogy. Organizations worldwide are currently going through challenging times to cope with changing business environments, strategies and processes. Downsizing, though widely implemented as a solution, is never the best answer to meeting these challenges. On the contrary, organizations need more and better human resources that can think and implement efficacious and competitive ways of employing existing or new resources.

In this respect, I believe that the IIMB graduates you recruit will be an asset to your organization.

Placement Calendar 2026-27

PGP & PGP BA

Pre-Placement Talks for Summer Placements	September to October 2026
Summer Placements Interviews 	26th – 31st October 2026
Summer Internship Schedule	April - May, 2027
Pre-Placement Talks and Interviews for Lateral Placements	November – January 2027
Pre-Placement Talks for Final Placements	November – January 2027
Final Placement Interviews	25th – 30th January 2027

Lateral Placements: The Lateral Placement Program at IIMB addresses the increasing need of corporates for management students with prior work experience. Lateral Recruitments are similar to graduate recruitments but are conducted over a more extended period of time keeping in mind the inherent requirements of such a process. The companies are free to undertake any specialized kind of intensive selection process as per their convenience. Candidates with more than 18 months of work experience only are eligible for the Lateral Recruitment process.

Summer Placements: Summer Placements for the first year students take place in the first/ second week of October or November every year.

EPGP 

Pre-Placement Talks	September to November 2026
Final Placement Interviews	12th – 18th November 2026
